basic_details.job_title: KSSM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM) is filling 2 Staff Nurse posts on contract under the 'Mittayi Project' at Government Medical Colleges, Alappuzha and Kottayam. The completed application, on the prescribed form attached to the notification, goes in person or by post to the Executive Director, Kerala Social Security Mission, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram. It must be submitted on or before 6 November 2026, 05.00 PM.

qualification.details: Qualification: MSc Nursing (Preferably peadiatric Nursing). Experience: The notification lists experience as "if any". It is one of the factors in selection, but the notice does not set a minimum. Age limit: Maximum 40 years, as on 06-11-2026. Mode of appointment: Contract. The successful candidate must sign a contract agreement with KSSM. The appointment carries consolidated pay and is initially for one year from the date of joining. Depending on the candidate's performance and integrity, the contract appointment may be extended as KSSM requires. Place of posting: Government Medical Colleges, Alappuzha and Kottayam. The application form asks you to name the district you are applying for. The notification does not give a separate number of posts for each college. | Only candidates with the prescribed qualification should apply. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: KSSM Staff Nurse at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Government Medical Colleges, Alappuzha and Kottayam

content_sections.heading: About KSSM
content_sections.text: The notification's letterhead describes Kerala Social Security Mission as "a Government of Kerala undertaking to cater to the social security needs of the underprivileged". Its office is in Thiruvananthapuram. The 'Mittayi Project' is an initiative of the Government of Kerala, Department of Social Justice, run under the guidance of KSSM. It provides comprehensive care to children and adolescents with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus in the State.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must fill in the application in the prescribed format attached to the notification. They then hand it in or post it to this address: Executive Director, Kerala Social Security Mission, IInd Floor, Day Care Centre for Aged, Social Welfare Institutional Complex, Poojappura – 695012, Thiruvananthapuram. The envelope must be superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF STAFF NURSE – MITTAYI PROJECT." The application must be submitted on or before 6 November 2026, 05.00 PM. The prescribed application form (pages 3 and 4 of the notification) asks for: Personal details: name, gender, date of birth (dd-mm-yyyy), age, religion, caste, category and native district, plus a space for a photo The district you are applying for (Alappuzha or Kottayam) Communication address, permanent address, mobile number and email Education: level, stream, subject, issuing authority, year of passing, registration number, result, marks (secured/total) and percentage or grade Work experience: name and address of the organisation, the post held, and the start date, end date and duration in completed months A signed declaration, with place and date KSSM will contact candidates only by email, and that includes the interview call letter. Applicants must therefore give a valid email ID on the form. The office email printed in the notification is [email protected] and the fax number is 0471-2346016. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: MSc Nursing (Preferably peadiatric Nursing). Experience: The notification lists experience as "if any". It is one of the factors in selection, but the notice does not set a minimum. Age limit: Maximum 40 years, as on 06-11-2026. Mode of appointment: Contract. The successful candidate must sign a contract agreement with KSSM. The appointment carries consolidated pay and is initially for one year from the date of joining. Depending on the candidate's performance and integrity, the contract appointment may be extended as KSSM requires. Place of posting: Government Medical Colleges, Alappuzha and Kottayam. The application form asks you to name the district you are applying for. The notification does not give a separate number of posts for each college. Only candidates with the prescribed qualification should apply. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: KSSM Staff Nurse Job Description
content_sections.text: Recording and maintenance of data Helping the Nodal officer in charge Data entry in the 'Mittayi' online portal Ensuring the proper distribution of CGM, Insulin Pump and Insulin to the beneficiaries Liaison with the parents Follow-up, and ensuring appropriate management of each case

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed format, completed in every respect, with a photo in the space provided Self-attested copies of the documents that support your qualification and any experience you claim. If they are missing, the application will be rejected. Offer letters, appointment orders, salary slips and similar papers are not accepted as proof of experience The originals must be produced at the interview or whenever KSSM asks for them

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for an immediate requirement. Selection will be based on qualification, experience (if any), and performance in a written test, an interview or both, as applicable. Applications that are not complete in every respect will not be considered for shortlisting. Ineligible applications will be rejected, and ineligible applicants may be removed at any stage of the recruitment. In both cases KSSM will not send any further communication.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test or interview. The declaration on the form states that if any information you give is found to be false or incorrect, your candidature may be cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSSM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Staff Nurse vacancies under the Mittayi Project at Government Medical Colleges, Alappuzha and Kottayam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KSSM Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted in person or by post on or before 6 November 2026, 05.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the KSSM Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The notification asks for MSc Nursing (Preferably peadiatric Nursing).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KSSM Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 40 years, as on 06-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a KSSM Staff Nurse under the Mittayi Project?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 34,180/- per month, paid as consolidated pay under a contract appointment.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for KSSM Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form attached to the notification and add self-attested copies of your documents. Then hand it in or post it to the Executive Director, Kerala Social Security Mission, IInd Floor, Day Care Centre for Aged, Social Welfare Institutional Complex, Poojappura – 695012, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF STAFF NURSE – MITTAYI PROJECT."

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the KSSM Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualification, experience (if any), and performance in a written test, an interview or both, as applicable. Incomplete applications are not considered for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q9. Is the KSSM Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract appointment, initially for one year from the date of joining. Depending on performance and integrity, it may be extended as KSSM requires.

faq.question: Q10. Will KSSM pay travel allowance for the written test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that no TA/DA will be paid for the written test or interview.
